description: Say you are doing it, and get it. With `id`, that guide — any kind: a task, a bug, a handoff. With no id, the next thing waiting — always something new, never what you hold. While you hold it no other agent can take it here, and its sender sees you are on it. You may hold several at once; the person watches them on the board. If somebody else has it, the answer says who — tell the user rather than doing the work twice. Every answer ends with what to call next.

any.description: a task for another repo, or none — only when the user asks

cwd.description: the worktree you are working in; default is the server's cwd

id.description: passalong id or share link; leave out for the next one

name: take
title: Take work
